proves.claim: With laneMode off, pullboard add files a web-lane item whose brief names a file in the docs lane folder.

cli.io-add.lanes-off-foreign-brief.why: Without it, a regression where a board with lanes off still refuses BRIEF_LANE on add would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: With laneMode on, pullboard add still refuses BRIEF_LANE naming the file outside the item lane.

cli.io-add.lanes-on-refused.why: Without it, a regression where the lanes-off bypass also drops the lane check with lanes on would pass unnoticed.

proves.claim: With laneMode off, pullboard edit --brief accepts a brief naming a file in another lane folder.

cli.io-add.lanes-off-edit-brief.why: Without it, a regression where edit still refuses BRIEF_LANE with lanes off would pass unnoticed.
